verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing pages say users can work with telemetry in natural language inside the product, and that the 'nightshift AI SRE' detects and investigates incidents and delivers root cause, which is a form of delegating investigative tasks to a built-in AI. The evidence is only two one-line marketing claims, with no documentation of the assistant's scope, actions or workflow. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the AI assistant's delegable tasks and actions, evidence it can do work beyond incident investigation and natural-language querying, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
